modelLicenseSource: README.md frontmatter and API cardData.license at the pinned revision

prohibited.note: Every entry is false: none of these is used, and none may be added after a result exists.

executionTimeVerification.revisionRetrievable: required — the pinned immutable revision must still resolve and serve inference.onnx
executionTimeVerification.licenseStillApacheTwo: required, re-read from the model card at the pinned revision
executionTimeVerification.upstreamHeadRule: A later upstream commit on the repository's default branch does NOT invalidate an immutable approved revision. Any change in the upstream head is recorded as an observation in upstream-head-observation.json, and the experiment proceeds with the exact pinned revision provided its bytes, sizes, configuration and licence still verify. Only a failure of those checks halts the run.
executionTimeVerification.failClosed: any hash, size, configuration or licence mismatch at the pinned revision halts before inference

vocabulary.establishedBy: merged PR #215 dictionary-audit.json, confirmed empirically when the probe emitted token 18709 at both space positions of its sentinel

intrinsicPreprocessing.resize: aspect-preserving to height 48, width min(ceil(48 * w / h), 320), cv2.resize with INTER_LINEAR
intrinsicPreprocessing.padding: always right-pad with zeros to width 320
intrinsicPreprocessing.paddingSpace: normalized (zero here is mid-grey, 127.5, in pixel space)
intrinsicPreprocessing.upstreamSource: resize_norm_img(padding=True) in ppocr/data/imaug/rec_img_aug.py at PaddleOCR commit 2661c7c0ef5c613e8f93c6e93b2e052399f0f854

decoding.softmaxRationale: The exported graph emits per-timestep probabilities, not logits: PR #215 measured row sums of 1.0 to within 4e-7, and PaddleOCR's own decoder takes argmax and max without a softmax. Applying softmax again would distort every probability while leaving the transcript unchanged.
